description: This file provides utility functions related to setuptools for building, distributing, and managing Python packages, including creating shims for setup.py invocation, bdist wheel, clean, develop, and egg_info commands.

methods.name: List[str] make_setuptools_shim_args( setup_py_path: str, global_options: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None, no_user_config: bool = False, unbuffered_output: bool = False, )
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for invoking setuptools setup.py with a shim, allowing customization for global options, no user config, and unbuffered output.

methods.name: List[str] make_setuptools_bdist_wheel_args( setup_py_path: str, global_options: Sequence[str], build_options: Sequence[str], destination_dir: str, )
methods.description: Creates arguments for building a wheel distribution from setup.py, specifying output directory.

methods.name: List[str] make_setuptools_clean_args( setup_py_path: str, global_options: Sequence[str], )
methods.description: Creates arguments to clean build artifacts of a setup.py project.

methods.name: List[str] make_setuptools_develop_args( setup_py_path: str, *, global_options: Sequence[str], no_user_config: bool, prefix: Optional[str], home: Optional[str], use_user_site: bool, )
methods.description: Creates arguments for installing a package in development mode with options for prefix, home directory, and user site usage.

methods.name: List[str] make_setuptools_egg_info_args( setup_py_path: str, egg_info_dir: Optional[str], no_user_config: bool, )
methods.description: Creates arguments for generating egg-info metadata for a project, with optional egg-info directory.
